description: This script imports and processes chart of accounts data from OpenERP sources, including parsing XML and CSV files, building account and chart hierarchies, and generating JSON chart files and a summary of root accounts.

methods.name: go
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the import process: loads account types, processes directories, reads XML and CSV files, builds account and chart structures, and generates output files.

methods.name: get_default_account_types
methods.description: Loads default account types from a predefined XML file.

methods.name: get_xml_roots
methods.description: Parses XML files to extract root elements for specific account models.

methods.name: get_csv_contents
methods.description: Reads CSV files related to account templates, types, and charts.

methods.name: get_account_types
methods.description: Extracts account type information from XML roots and CSV data, mapping codes to account types.

methods.name: make_maps_for_xml
methods.description: Creates mappings for accounts and charts from XML data.

methods.name: make_maps_for_csv
methods.description: Creates mappings for accounts and charts from CSV data.

methods.name: make_account_trees
methods.description: Builds hierarchical account trees based on parent-child relationships.

methods.name: make_charts
methods.description: Generates JSON files for account charts and updates the account hierarchy.

methods.name: create_all_roots_file
methods.description: Outputs a text file listing all root account files and their root accounts.
